Subject: Broken heater in Apartment 4B, repair requested within 48 hours

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in Apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called you about it on October 3 and haven't heard back since.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s, and the apartment gets cold enough that it's hard to sleep. Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat, so I'm asking you to have the heater repaired within 48 hours of this email.

If someone can tell me when a technician will come, I'll make sure I'm available to let them in. A short reply or call confirming the plan would be appreciated.

Thank you,
